title: Junior Java Developer
description: As a Junior Java Developer at CGI, you will join a collaborative team working on innovative client solutions. You’ll contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise-grade applications while continuously learning and growing your technical skills.
requirements: 0-2 years of experience in software development (internships or projects accepted)
Solid knowledge of Java and object-oriented programming
Familiarity with relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle)
Understanding of web development concepts (REST APIs, HTML/CSS/JavaScript)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
